Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Before we flip the switch on the pilot billing, AP is asking for a quick checklist so we can create HelioCloud as a vendor in our system and ensure invoices match your PO format. Two items for confirmation so we don’t hit payment delays:

1) PO anchoring: does HelioCloud require the PO number to be included in the invoice reference line AND the invoice filename? Our AP matching rules prefer both but can accept either if you indicate which you'll include.

2) VAT / tax treatment: you mentioned you have an EU VAT ID. Please confirm the VAT ID you want on invoices and whether you expect reverse-charge (customer account is in the EU) or net billing with VAT on top. Also let us know the registered billing address for the invoice.

I’ve attached our Redwood AP onboarding instructions (short checklist) to make the required fields explicit — if you can return your PO template and VAT cert we’ll push this through.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_onboarding_instructions.pdf (pdf)

Proposed next step: if you can reply with the PO template and VAT cert today, I’ll loop in Laura in finance to finalize payment rails.

Thanks,

- VAT: HelioCloud GmbH (DE) VAT ID: DE815203421. We are registered in Germany — we apply VAT where required. We can flag the invoice with the reverse-charge note: "VAT reverse charge — Article 44 EU VAT Directive" and include your (Redwood’s) VAT ID on the invoice.
- Billing address: HelioCloud GmbH, Fasanenstrasse 12, 10623 Berlin, Germany.

I’ve attached: HelioCloud_PO_template.docx (docx) and VAT_certificate.pdf (pdf).

Thanks Jordan — good, clean set of docs from Sarah. Answers below and next steps so we can set up the vendor record without delay: 

1) Vendor master classification: yes, create HelioCloud as an "EU vendor (VAT registered)" in our vendor master. Capture VAT ID: DE815203421 and billing address as provided. That will toggle our reverse-charge accounting treatment.

2) PO & invoice matching: Acceptable — instruct AP matching to look for PO number in invoice reference and filename. I will add a matching rule exception for HelioCloud to accept either reference field if there's a minor formatting mismatch (common with international names).

3) Payment terms & rails: set standard Net 45 for this pilot (we'll re-evaluate at renewal). HelioCloud's bank details are present in their PO template — before the first invoice, we do not require a $1 test payment for EU vendors unless a SWIFT confirmation is requested. If we run into bank rejections, we will ask for a zero-amount confirmation or a remittance advice.

4) Invoicing notes: since they requested reverse-charge, ensure invoices include: 
   - HelioCloud VAT ID (DE815203421)
   - Redwood VAT ID: GB999887776 (we store in vendor notes)
   - Phrase: "Reverse charge — Article 44 EU VAT Directive"

5) Records & attachments: I created a preliminary vendor CSV with the core fields for vendor master. Please upload the attachments and the vendor row to Finance Vendor Intake (linked) and tag the record HC-9802.

Attachments: HelioCloud_vendor_record.csv (csv)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HC-9802
